scope: Three unresolved South Dakota critical-access hospital CCNs with Avera price-page leads
official_price_page_observation: The South Dakota Standard Charges section currently displays distinct Bowdle, Eureka hospital, and Freeman CSV links.

cases.official_hospital_page_observation: Avera describes Eureka Community Health Services Avera at 200 J Ave as a six-bed Critical Access Hospital.
cases.distinct_nearby_site_observation: Avera Eureka Health Care Center is described as a nursing and assisted-living site at 202 J Ave; its name must not alone identify the 200 J Ave hospital.
cases.browser_result: Access Denied; no CSV bytes obtained
cases.identity_decision: Potential hospital file lead, but pointer location label conflicts with first-party hospital-versus-nursing-site names; file metadata remains unverified.

cases.official_system_page_observation: Avera places Freeman Regional Health Services at 510 E 8th St and lists Freeman Medical Center as its 25-bed Critical Access Hospital, alongside a nursing home, clinic and assisted-living facility.
cases.browser_result: Access Denied after navigation; no CSV bytes obtained
cases.identity_decision: Shared-system address and label are a lead, not file-level proof of the hospital campus or scope.

cases.official_hospital_page_observation: Bowdle Healthcare Center's first-party site has a Bowdle Hospital page; the parent organization also includes non-hospital services.
cases.browser_result: Access Denied; no CSV bytes obtained
cases.identity_decision: Organization-level page and link are a lead, not file-level proof of Bowdle Hospital's declared location.

disposition: All three remain unresolved. Preserve the current page links as leads and the 403/browser denials as access observations. Do not promote any CCN or infer file absence, complete-file validity, or legal compliance without exact-file bytes and identity metadata.
next_action: Obtain authorized exact-file bytes through a materially different access path or a publisher-provided copy; compare declared hospital/location/address, date, and template version for each CCN before reviewed resolution.
